gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 83.1m (2013: GBP 59.1m) is an improvement of GBP 6.4m to claims reserves established at the prior year end.
gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1861 reported a prior year reserve release of GBP 6.4 million, representing a 3.49% reduction in opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was attributed to a generally benign catastrophe year, lower than expected attritional and large loss activity, beneficial developments in prior year reserves, favourable loss ratios across the re-positioned portfolio, and the resolution of certain legacy issues. The most significant favourable development occurred on the 2012 year of account, particularly in the Property (Direct & Facultative), Marine (Hull & Liability), and Starr Tech Onshore (Casualty) classes.
